title: Comprehensive Integration and Certification
objectives: Demonstrate rapid, calibrated identification of all eligible taxa from unfamiliar single-organ and mixed evidence.
Complete cumulative scientific-name retrieval in both directions.
Pass separate foliage, bark, reproductive, dormant, whole-tree/regional, and rapid mixed-evidence batteries.
Synthesize field silvics across site, regeneration, disturbance, succession, condition, and management.
Produce a final numerical grade and a separate species-by-modality mastery and certification report.

confuserSets.name: Sugar / black / Norway maple
confuserSets.keySeparators: Petiole latex; leaf underside hair and stipules; bud size/shape; samara angle
confuserSets.resolvingViews: Fresh-broken petiole; lower surface; terminal bud; ripe samara

confuserSets.name: Red / silver maple
confuserSets.keySeparators: Sinus depth; lower-surface whiteness; spring samara size; twig odor; bark strips
confuserSets.resolvingViews: Complete leaf underside; samara with scale; crushed twig; mature bark

confuserSets.name: Striped / mountain maple
confuserSets.keySeparators: Green-white striped bark versus unstriped; leaf size/base; fruit cluster posture; growth form
confuserSets.resolvingViews: Young stem; intact leaf; fruit cluster; whole plant

confuserSets.name: White / green / black ash

expectedSilvicsRetrieval.response_standard: Certification prompts span at least site, regeneration, disturbance, and management and require field-usable synthesis.

sessions.title: Rapid identification and remediation triage
sessions.delivery: rapid unfamiliar drills with no new taxa

sessions.title: Confusers and insufficient evidence
sessions.delivery: isolated and side-by-side confuser drills with requested-view reasoning

sessions.title: Certification modality rehearsal
sessions.delivery: separate foliage bark reproductive dormant and whole-tree stations

sessions.title: Silvics and regional synthesis
sessions.delivery: oral or written synthesis and final targeted retrieval

teachingBoundary: This package contains labeled instruction and public module structure only. Retrieval stations are assembled separately from admitted practice media, and formal forms, examination media, answer keys, and learner records remain private.
